title: How to Sell OneCoin on the Internal Exchange
description: Since July 15, the internal exchange has been operational, where OneCoin company partners can buy and sell...

asr.full_text: Hello, Elena Palikova with you and in this video I will show you how you can sell one coin on our internal exchange. So let's translate the content of the site into Russian If we want to sell or buy tokens, we will click on this triangle and go to the tokens section. Now we are interested in selling VanCoin, so we click on the request button. And a frame appears, in which we will indicate the information, how many VanCoins we would like to sell today. For example, let's say I want to sell 10 van-coins. The price today is 1.484 euros. In total, for ten van-coins, we get 14.48 euros. In the last line of the trade password is our financial password, which we set when registering. And press the button to place the order. Your order has been saved successfully. Ok. During the day or at the very least tomorrow, we will be able to see this money which will come to us, for sale of Wancoins in a Management Panel in the relevant section on the Personal Account. Well, I hope this this video helps you sell your WANCOIN on our internal exchanges. Good day to you all and good mood. Elena Palkova is with you. See you soon.

textual.potential_relevance: A promised near-term monetary return is linked to following an exchange workflow and placing a token-sale order.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the quoted price or proceeds were accurate, whether settlement occurred, or whether the exchange was legitimate. Token names vary across the records and may reflect ASR transcription differences.

visual.observation: A OneCoin-branded dashboard visibly displays account balances and bonus-related figures, including "ВСЕГО ONE COINS 1 868.02", "СЧЕТ НАЛИЧНЫХ 28.92", "БАЛЛЫ ОНЛАЙН 27 000", and "ОБЩИЙ БОНУС ЗА ЗАРАБОТАНО 150.00"; a countdown labeled "ДО СЛЕДУЮЩЕГО БОНУСНОГО РАУНДА" is also visible.
visual.context: Visible account dashboard for a OneCoin-branded service; the sampled frames do not show accompanying narration or the terms governing these figures.
visual.potential_relevance: The interface links a branded account presentation and bonus-related amounts with a time-limited next-bonus countdown, which may merit review as a reward/return presentation with stated timing conditions.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish what the balances or bonuses represent, whether they are redeemable, who operates the service, or whether any payment or action is requested.

visual.observation: The dashboard visibly shows a "Рейтинг лидеров" panel stating "YOU DO NOT QUALIFY FOR A LEADERBOARD RANK YET" alongside participant names and country flags.
visual.context: Visible leaderboard/status panel within the branded dashboard.
visual.potential_relevance: The interface connects participant ranking/status with the account dashboard and an eligibility condition, which may merit review if the broader source links ranking to rewards or recruitment; that relationship is not shown here.
visual.limitations: No reward, recruitment instruction, payment requirement, or other consequence of leaderboard qualification is visible.

visual.observation: A trading interface visibly presents an exchange graph and buy/sell controls for ONE, with displayed current, high, and low values and transaction panels.
visual.context: The sampled frames show a platform trading screen and market interface; context beyond the interface is unclear.
visual.potential_relevance: The interface links displayed asset values to buy/sell actions and transaction areas, which may merit review as a financial transfer workflow if the source presents these actions as a route to a promised return.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish that a transaction completed, that funds were transferred, that returns were promised, or who would receive any payment.

visual.observation: A visible sell-order form contains fields for number of coins, current sell price, transaction cost, a date, and a password, and shows an available minimum amount for a sell order of 50.00 EUR; the amount is filled as 10 and a button labeled "Разместить заказ" is visible.
visual.context: Visible demonstration or use of a sell-order form; the sampled frames do not show accompanying explanation.
visual.potential_relevance: The form links an asset-sale request to a password field, transaction fee, minimum order condition, and order-submission action, which may merit review as a money-flow workflow with access and eligibility conditions.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish whether the password is submitted, whether the order is accepted or settled, whether the account holder is authorized, or whether any loss occurs.

visual.observation: After the sell-order form is filled, a browser dialog visibly states "The page at https://www.onecoin.eu says: Your order has been successfully" and includes an OK button.
visual.context: Visible browser confirmation dialog following the displayed sell-order workflow.
visual.potential_relevance: The dialog links the preceding order-submission action to a claimed successful order result, which may merit review as an observable transaction-status claim.
visual.limitations: The message is truncated, and the frames do not establish what order was processed, whether any asset or money moved, or whether the result was independently verified.

visual_context_notes.observation: The sampled frames consistently show OneCoin branding, including the logo and a branded dashboard/trading interface.
The interface visibly includes payment-card logos and a "Verified by Visa" mark near the bottom of the trading pages.
The dashboard visibly shows changing countdown values next to the label "ДО СЛЕДУЮЩЕГО БОНУСНОГО РАУНДА" across sampled frames.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it presents a first-person tutorial for selling OneCoin through an internal exchange, pairing a stated sale value and expected near-term proceeds with instructions to submit an order. The demonstrated flow connects the token sale to entry of a financial password, transaction conditions, and an order-submission control, with an order-success message shown after submission. Bonus figures and a countdown are visible on the branded dashboard, but the available video evidence does not establish what those figures represent, whether the quoted proceeds were paid, or whether the order settled.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S05 is the closest supported subtype because the content presents token participation through a token-sale exchange and links that activity to stated euro proceeds expected within a short period. The evidence shows a sale workflow rather than an explicit purchase, appreciation, dividend or holding-return claim, so the fit is partial.
